title: NPHIES-AI Mastery | BrainSAIT Training
titleArabic: إتقان الذكاء الاصطناعي مع نفيس | تدريب برينسيت

sections.heading: Course Description
sections.content: This course is designed specifically for Saudi healthcare teams who need to operationalise NPHIES compliance using AI-powered automation. It covers FHIR R4 integration pipelines, real-time claims validation, Oracle ERP bridging, and full compliance workflows — all framed around practical deployment with BrainSAIT's ClaimLinc ecosystem.

sections.heading: وصف الدورة
sections.content: تم تصميم هذه الدورة خصيصًا لفرق الرعاية الصحية في المملكة العربية السعودية الذين يحتاجون إلى تفعيل الامتثال لنظام (نفيس NPHIES) باستخدام الأتمتة المدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعي. يغطي البرنامج مسارات تكامل FHIR R4، والتحقق الفوري من المطالبات الطبية، وربط نظام Oracle ERP، والامتثال الكامل - كل ذلك ضمن تطبيق عملي مع نظام ClaimLinc من BrainSAIT.

sections.heading: Focus Areas
sections.content:
- **⚡ Automated Solutions:** Leverage AI and ML to streamline clinical and operational NPHIES workflows efficiently.
- **🔗 Integrated Systems:** Bridge healthcare requirements through FHIR R4 interoperability and Oracle ERP connectivity.
- **📈 Tech-Driven Growth:** Master scalable NPHIES automation deployments for enterprise Saudi healthcare providers.

sections.heading: Curriculum
sections.content:
- **Module 1: Collective Brainpower Foundations**
Build a decision-making model that aligns physicians, operators, founders, and technical teams around a shared digital roadmap.
- **Module 2: Automation in Healthcare Operations**
Identify high-leverage automation opportunities across patient journeys, compliance workflows, analytics, and back-office execution.
- **Module 3: Integrated Digital Health Systems**
Design interoperable systems that connect clinical requirements, data contracts, AI services, and business processes.
- **Module 4: AI Strategy for Health-Tech Growth**
Translate AI capabilities into product strategy, founder positioning, and scalable market execution for healthcare ventures.

sections.heading: Learning Outcomes
sections.content:
- [x] Map automation opportunities across healthcare workflows and business operations.
- [x] Design interoperable digital systems that connect product, data, and service delivery.
- [x] Create an actionable AI adoption plan aligned with real startup or enterprise priorities.
- [x] Turn collective expertise into repeatable execution systems for growth and transformation.
